name: Staff of Hunting
body:
Source Dragonslayer's Handbook pg. 31
Aura strong varies CL 13th
Slot none; Price 51,000 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Description
This length of aged ivory is carved with numerous hunting scenes which seem to animate and tell a story when the staff is rotated. It allows the use of the following spells:
Acute sensesUM (1 charge)
Bard’s escapeAPG (4 charges)
Locate creature (2 charges)
Unwilling shieldAPG (3 charges)
Construction
Requirements Craft Staff, acute sensesUM, bard’s escapeAPG, locate creature, unwilling shieldAPG; Cost 25,500 gp
